THIS CRIMINAL APPEAL IS FILED U/S 14A(2) OF SC/ST (POA) ACT, 1989 R/W SECTION 439 OF CR.P.C., SEEKING TO ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN KAMALAPUR POLICE STATION CRIME NO.54/2020, PENDING ON THE FILE I ADDL.
DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE, AT BELLARY IN SPECIAL CASE NO. 1324/2020 FOR OFFENCE PUNISHABLE U/Ss. 363,
376(I)(N) OF IPC, U/Ss. 4 AND 6 OF POSCO, ACT, 2012 AND U/S. 3(2)(V-a) OF SC/ST POA ACT, 1989.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT Learned counsel for the appellant submits that, he may be permitted to withdraw the appeal.
His submission is placed on record.
In view of the above submission, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
JUDGE KGR*
